reason: I've never heard of Nora Furnish, and $360 for a pendant from a store I can't vouch for is a lot when I can order lighting on Prime with easy returns. Ten to twelve business days plus paying return shipping if I change my mind doesn't help either.
objection: Unknown brand at $360 with no reviews or track record I can check, and I'd eat the return shipping if it looks different in my house.
